cases.question: 统计已完成订单消费金额最高的前五名客户。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5
cases.fake_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 按城市统计已完成订单数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.city
cases.fake_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.city

cases.question: 已完成订单中销售额最高的五种产品是什么？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_amount),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 5

cases.question: 已完成订单中销量最高的三种产品是什么？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 3
